text: 10月31日，商务部党组书记、部长王文涛主持召开党组专题会议，传达学习党的二十届五中全会精神，研究部署学习贯彻工作。会议要求，要统筹做好岁末年初各项工作，以全面从严治党新效能激发商务高质量发展新动能，巩固拓展树立和践行正确政绩观学习教育成果，积极做好扩消费稳外贸稳外资、多双边经贸合作等重点工作，为推动经济持续向新向优向好发展、实现“十五五”良好开局作出积极贡献。
text_en: On October 31, Wang Wentao, Party Secretary and Minister of Commerce, chaired a special meeting of the Party Leadership Group to convey and study the spirit of the Fifth Plenary Session of the 20th CPC Central Committee and to plan and deploy the work of studying and implementing it. The meeting required coordinating all work at the end of the year and the beginning of next year, stimulating new momentum for high-quality commerce development through the new effectiveness of full and rigorous Party self-governance, consolidating and expanding the results of education on establishing and practicing a correct view of political performance, and actively advancing key tasks such as expanding consumption and stabilizing foreign trade and foreign investment and bilateral and multilateral economic and trade cooperation, so as to contribute to promoting sustained, new and improved economic development and achieving a good start for the 15th Five-Year Plan.
